description: India's largest decorative paints company, with a dense dealer network, a growing waterproofing and home-improvement portfolio, and ongoing capacity and digital investments.

signals.description: Continued capacity and depot-network expansion to support decorative and waterproofing demand.
signals.evidence: Public coverage of plant and network investments plus official company materials.

signals.description: Category leadership in decorative paints with a push into adjacent home-improvement services.
signals.evidence: Market and company overview sources collected in research.

signals.description: Digital and dealer-facing technology investment to manage a very large channel.
signals.evidence: Hiring and technology signals around channel and supply systems.

signals.description: Technology and supply-chain hiring around planning, data, and dealer systems.
signals.evidence: Public hiring and technology research snippets.

pain_points: SKU and depot complexity makes consensus demand planning slow
Dealer and painter-program performance is hard to see before month-end
New-depot and new-category ramps need cleaner sell-out data
why_relevant_to_user: Asian Paints is a textbook NexusFlow ICP: a branded coatings leader with thousands of dealers, a festive-and-monsoon demand cycle, and live expansion. Demand Planning and TradePulse map directly to supply and channel pain.
sources: Public market and expansion coverage from research tools

description: Integrated steel producer with large Indian plants, a long-running manufacturing-excellence program, and public Industry 4.0 / digital plant initiatives.
products_services: Industrial solutions for auto and construction

signals.description: Active Industry 4.0 and plant-digitalization programs across major sites.
Ongoing capex and reliability programs at core Indian plants.
signals.evidence: Capacity and operations commentary in public sources.

signals.description: Digital manufacturing, reliability, and data roles around plant operations.
signals.evidence: Public hiring signals for manufacturing-digital roles.

pain_points: Plant and central teams do not always share the same downtime picture
Exception reviews still wait on monthly MIS in some lines
New digital tools fail if they ask plants to abandon the existing MES
why_relevant_to_user: Tata Steel is a PlantConnect fit: multiple large plants, a serious digital-manufacturing agenda, and buyers who will reject anything that rips out MES. The conversation is plant visibility, not another historian rip-and-replace.

description: Electricals and durables brand with a wide dealer network across lighting, switchgear, fans, and related categories, plus continued channel and brand investment.

signals.description: Channel and category expansion across electricals and durables.
Sustained brand-led growth in a fragmented electricals trade.
Influencer and electrician programs sit next to a large dealer base.

pain_points: Dealer health is still reviewed too late for regional managers
Electrician and influencer program spend is hard to attribute
New-geography channel design needs cleaner secondary-sales data
why_relevant_to_user: Havells is a TradePulse conversation: a branded electricals network, electrician/influencer programs, and regional managers who still run a lot of the channel from lagging reports.
